- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:13060-13086 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Added a defensive guard to prevent destructive state reconstruction when the comments fetch fails. Previously, a failed/unvalidated comments fetch was misread as "orchestrator state missing", triggering rebuild_tracking_state which can spawn duplicate issues.
  WHY: A paginated fetch that exhausts retries results in COMMENTS_FETCH_OK="false" and COMMENTS="[]", but the code path didn't check COMMENTS_FETCH_OK before reconstruction. The empty result was wrongly treated as "no state exists" (root cause: project #3627 incident).
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:test_failed_comments_fetch_skips_state_reconstruction (lines 10234-10287) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: New regression test validates the guard behavior. The test forces the comments GET to fail and asserts reconstruction is skipped.
  WHY: This test is part of the fix delivery and verifies the regression is prevented going forward. Without this test, the fix could regress silently.
